purpose: One separately authorized attempt to verify corrected Docker Desktop startup with an empty running engine, then immediately leave the guarded scope and verify shutdown. This is not Keycloak acquisition or native integration acceptance.

previous_incident.supported_startup_crash_cause: Private operator wrapper clean_environment omitted ProgramData; Docker reported unable to get ProgramData before engine readiness.

ordered_steps: Root reviews the exact driver, unchanged guard, plan and mocked test results. No preparation step runs native CLI status/help, services, VM, network or host settings.
Obtain fresh explicit authorization for exactly one startup-only attempt on this host. A reference string records that decision; neither this plan nor the string grants permission.

Validate the supplied fixed absolute installed docker.exe and every ancestor as not redirected. Validate the approval reference, intended signalbridge-public checkout and preserved existing Windows paths including ProgramData and SystemDrive before any process operation.
Create and secure a fresh private diagnostic stage. Hash the reviewed driver, plan, guard, capacity probe, clean-environment launcher and private ACL script.
Capture whole-host free disk locally before startup; sample available physical memory and fixed reserves. Do not use the old incident baseline or accept an operator-supplied baseline.
Enter the unchanged guard. Require preserved existing ProgramData and SystemDrive plus validated Windows paths, observed stopped Desktop, no reachable foreign workloads and capacity admission.
Arm the independent watchdog and validate its ready marker before the one recorded start intent. The existing guard calls desktop start exactly once and waits within its fixed deadlines.

Verify observed running Desktop, reachable empty Linux engine inventory and fixed capacity. Recheck the existing guard and leave scope immediately; do not perform acquisition or hand off to another controller.

Existing scope exit marks finished, settles its own CLI child and waits for the independent bounded shutdown. Shutdown does not require successful engine inventory but preserves any reachable foreign running containers.

Bind context, ready, intent, finished, watchdog and launcher receipts to this guard run, approval, captured baseline and deadline. Recheck stopped status and capacity once after scope exit. Retain CLI failures, timeouts, resource overshoot, missing receipts or unverified shutdown as incomplete.
Retain the private diagnostic stage and all guard files. Write only the minimal public startup result and receipt hashes. Stop after this attempt; do not retry automatically.
excluded_actions: No downloads, installs, dependency acquisition, image queries, pulls, builds, container creation or lab execution.
No Keycloak, PostgreSQL, application, Wazuh or native integration controller invocation.
No WSL distribution termination, VM configuration changes, host startup settings, trust-store, firewall or network changes.
No deletion of volumes, images, caches, incident evidence or other project data.
No automatic second attempt or permanent service monitor.

retained_outputs.successful_result_requires: Observed running and empty engine, capacity within every retained sample, matching lifecycle receipts, both launcher/watchdog shutdown assertions, bounded stopped observation, final stopped status, no pending guard or retained CLI errors.

recovery: A capacity breach, startup failure or driver failure closes the guarded scope; the armed watchdog performs bounded shutdown even when the container engine is unreachable.
A reachable foreign running workload is preserved. That state cannot pass this diagnostic; no shutdown of another project's containers is authorized.
Shutdown or status failure, pending watchdog, CLI timeout or missing/cross-run receipt remains incomplete. Keep private receipts; notify the owner and review before any additional native action.

If Desktop reappears after the finite drain, its origin remains unknown. This plan does not authorize a later stop, configuration change or retry; any necessary recovery action needs authorization covering that action.
No destructive cleanup is part of recovery.
limits_of_conclusion: Sampled limits detect pressure and can overshoot; this driver does not impose hard host or VM quotas. Previous whole-host decrease was approximately 38.4 GiB and later available RAM approximately 0.44 GiB.
An observed stopped state during a 30-second drain does not prove settlement of every daemon request or permanent absence of a delayed independent startup.
The later unexplained startup origin and the previous resource spike cause remain unestablished even if this diagnostic passes.
The unchanged guard records a legacy acquisition phase after startup; this driver performs no acquisition and grants no acquisition authority.

This preparation and its mocked tests do not establish successful corrected native startup. A future passing diagnostic establishes only this one startup and bounded shutdown, never Keycloak, SSO, MFA or native integration acceptance.
Local hashes bind retained bytes, not independent attestation or protection from a trusted local administrator.
